title: Soul Revolution 3
text: a real soul revolution comes online when many people at once have this insight have this Revelation experience what's possible see what's possible recognize what's possible when many people at once have their minds and their hearts completely blown open that's when we see the future that's when we experience pure positivity it sees through all falsehood it sees through all doubt and it sees through all fear and when we can see the fire of that purity which is the nature of this Atlas higher energy and intelligence when we can see it together at the same time we can do we know we can do anything it's this kind of experience that catalyzes the revolution of the soul that I'm talking about
